name: record-lookup
title: Record lookup
description: Pick one record from a big table: a field with a Look up button that opens a searchable, sortable, paged table in a dialog, loaded from your server.
docs: Give it columns ({ key, label, sortable, align, width }) and loadRows(query, signal), which answers { rows, total } for { search, page, pageSize, sort }, so the data can stay on the server. Each new question aborts the one before it, and a late answer is dropped even when your loader ignores the signal. Control the chosen record with value and onValueChange ({ id, plus a value per column key }; null when cleared). The field shows the record named by labelKey (the first column) with a muted line from detailKey (the second). In the dialog, Arrow Down moves from the search field into the rows, Enter in the field takes the chosen row or the first result, and Enter or a double click on a row takes it. title names the dialog, pageSize sets the rows, name sends the id with a form, labels translates the words. A width on any column (a CSS length, '12rem') fixes the layout, so the columns keep their places from one answer to the next and a long value is cut with an ellipsis; a column without a width shares what is left, and without any widths the table fits its columns to what it shows. The table keeps the room of a whole page so the dialog does not change height, and on a short screen it gives way and scrolls inside itself, so the paging, Select and Cancel are never covered. RecordLookupPanel is the same table without the dialog.
